# Vendored libraries

- `exceljs.min.js`: ExcelJS 4.4.0 (MIT, see `exceljs.LICENSE.txt`), browser build from the npm package `exceljs@4.4.0` (`dist/exceljs.min.js`) with the source-map comment removed. Loaded on demand by the Import / Export tab; it makes no network requests.

To refresh: `npm install` then `npm run vendor`.
